preferred: real product UI screenshots on neutral background
high-contrast data charts with verbatim source labels
acquisition_sources: founder smartphone shot list (60fps natural window light)
clean browser viewport UI capture (2x retina)
customer-approved UGC clips with signed usage rights
forbidden_visual_tropes: generic glowing AI brains or neon robots
fake countdown timers or deceptive red notification badges

9:16.safe_zone: Keep copy & logos within center 75% vertical band; reserve top 14% for handle and bottom 20% for IG/FB/TikTok captions & link stickers.

4:5.safe_zone: Minimum 64px outer padding; headline <= 8 words in top 25% focal zone.

1:1.safe_zone: Minimum 48px margin; single focal metric or product frame per slide.

1.91:1.safe_zone: Zero text on native thumbnail image where required; <= 20% text area on GDN/social link cards.

16:9.safe_zone: Left-aligned headline <= 7 words; caption-ready lower third.
